name: Action on an Approved Application/Petition (Form I-824)
name_pt: Ação sobre Petição Já Aprovada (Formulário I-824)
name_es: Acción sobre Petición Ya Aprobada (Formulario I-824)
note: "Activates" an already-approved case -- duplicate approval notice, sends the case to NVC, or follow-to-join for family members. Does not create a new case. Precision-critical: must match the original petition exactly.

phases.name: Document Collection
documents: Original approval notice (I-797 -- NOA2 or approval notice)
Passport or proof of U.S. status (petitioner)
documents_pt: Aviso de aprovação original (I-797 -- NOA2 ou aviso de aprovação)
Passaporte ou comprovante de status nos EUA (peticionário)
Documentos de apoio do caso original
documents_es: Aviso de aprobación original (I-797 -- NOA2 o aviso de aprobación)
Pasaporte o comprobante de estatus en EE. UU. (peticionario)
Copia de la I-130/I-140 (si está disponible)
Documentos de apoyo del caso original
steps: Confirm case number and type of original petition (I-130, I-140, etc.) and date of approval

Define the purpose of the I-824 (select the correct one): send case to NVC (consular processing) / request duplicate approval notice / follow-to-join request (family members) / request USCIS notify another office
Gather proof of eligibility for the requested action
Draft explanation letter: reason for filing, details of requested action, clarification of inconsistencies (recommended)

phases.name: Case Preparation
steps: Define the request purpose clearly (e.g., 1.a -- a duplicate approval notice)
Align supporting evidence (timeline of not receiving the original document)
Strategy: purpose must be clearly stated, must match original petition exactly, no inconsistencies with previous filing -- delays are common, accuracy is critical

phases.name: Finalization
steps: If NVC: follow the consular process

pricing.notes: 'All-Inclusive Package' — no Plus tier, and (unlike I-290B) no mandatory consultation fee.
